FACTSHEET Financing sustainability in Greece with public policy instruments Summary: To facilitate Greece's green transition and achieve net-zero emissions by 2050, this project aims to support Greek Authorities in crafting policies to promote the financing of sustainable/green investments. Following the identification of barriers and the quantification of the related investment gap, the project results in the development of a National Strategy for Sustainable Finance and a relevant Action Plan.
